recommended_sequence: Use a practical characterization or RF lab first to establish whether a measurable Worldshepherd-specific effect exists.
For WS-AlTi, use accessible chemistry/microstructure/phase/property screening before escalating to national-laboratory manufacturing or high-end characterization.
For the adaptive metasurface, choose one band inside an available calibrated range and establish S-parameter plus pattern behavior before asking for traceability-grade metrology.
Use a national-lab or traceability-grade facility only after the internal/preliminary signal and evidence package justify the cost and access burden.
Keep manufacturing, characterization, analysis, and independent replication separable so one organization does not become the sole source of the claimed result.
